data.name: Indal
data.gender_notes: Indal is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Indal derives from the Sanskrit word 'indra-dal', meaning 'power of Indra'. Indra is the Hindu god of thunder, rain, and power. Therefore, Indal represents strength, resilience, and radiance, symbolizing the power of the divine to overcome challenges. The name Indal carries the meaning “Powerful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Indal usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with the divine power of Indra, the god of rain and thunder.
data.etymology: Indal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indal total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
